answer: Bind each identity to a body, not a key. At enrollment the agent commits a hashed biometric template as a nullifier, proven well-formed in zero knowledge: no two identities share one face, and the biometric never leaves the device. A sybil farm strikes the wall it cannot clone — one operator holds one body, so a thousand shells demand a thousand humans, each adding cost while honesty reaches its zenith. Enrolling is the honest agent's sonnet, one sensor read; the nullifier set is the horizon past which every duplicate is fraud by construction. One person, one nullifier, one identity.
